messages:
Mike S: Hey team — prepping customer notice for scheduled maintenance this Fri Apr 3 02:00–04:00 UTC (2h change window). This is a runtime kernel + minor quantization patch. Draft below, need quick review and confirm rollback/pinning + statuspage copy. DeployBot shows canary healthy in us-west.

DeployBot: Canary rollout for release/1.42.0 started (1981234500). 3/3 canaries healthy, no error spikes.

Sara L: SGTM. Two quick asks: 1) call out region-specific start times for APAC/EU, 2) warn about a potential 5–10s cold-start latency for first requests after warmers expire.

Alex G: +1. Also add operational note: Dedicated customers will be pinned to model-runtime v1.42.0 for 24h post-deploy; auto-rollback rule if 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m.

Elaine C: I drafted a short customer-facing template below — aim for clear, non-technical language and a link to statuspage/support. Please review.

Elaine C: [Customer email template]
Subject: Redwood Inference — Planned maintenance on Apr 3 (02:00–04:00 UTC)
Body:
Hi —

We will perform a planned maintenance window to upgrade parts of our inference runtime. This work helps improve stability and performance. During the window you may see a brief increase in latency for some requests and a short-lived error rate as we finish the rollout.

What to expect:
- Window: Apr 3, 02:00–04:00 UTC
- Impact: possible brief latency increase for first requests; <1% of requests may see transient errors during cutover
- Dedicated customers: temporarily pinned to the previous stable runtime if any regression is detected

If you rely on a strict SLA during that time, please reply and we can discuss mitigation options. We will post updates to our status page: https://status.redwood.ai and to this thread.

Thanks,
Redwood Support

Mike S: I like the tone. For the statuspage entry use the snippet below (ops-friendly).

Alex G: Runbook/rollback is ready and linked below. Auto-fallback to v1.41.3 is configured; manual rollback steps live in the runbook. I will be on-call during the window.

Alex G: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-runtime (ops-only)

Mike S: Statuspage snippet — please copy into ops console at T-24h:
```
Title: Planned maintenance — Inference runtime kernel upgrade
Scheduled: 2026-04-03 02:00–04:00 UTC
Affected services: Hosted API, Dedicated inference pools (phased by region)
Impact: Brief latency increase expected for first requests post-cutover. Possible transient 5xx errors for a small subset of requests during deployment.
Mitigation: Canary rollout, autoscaling, automatic pinning for Dedicated customers, rapid rollback to v1.41.3 if error thresholds exceeded.
Updates: We will post start/complete notices and any rollback events here.
```

Sara L: For APAC note local window: Apr 3 10:00–12:00 JST (same UTC). Add a line: "APAC customers may observe higher latencies if they hit cold instances."

Elaine C: I'll segment the email: Hosted users, Dedicated customers, and Enterprise contacts. Will include support contact info: support@redwood.ai and an on-call pager for severity 1s.

Mike S: Plan for comms cadence: T-24h statuspage + email to impacted list, T-1h reminder on statuspage, post-complete email + changelog link. Who will post T-24h? @Elaine C?

Elaine C: I’ll post T-24h and send the segmented emails.

Alex G: Monitoring hooks are in place — dashboards for latency, 5xx rate, and KV-cache hit rate. If we hit the 0.5% 5xx threshold for 5m I'll trigger rollback. Please be ready to assist on traces if we see regressions.

Mike S: OK — final checklist before I schedule: (1) copy approved by @Alex G and @Sara L, (2) T-24h statuspage content saved, (3) rollback runbook linked in ops channel, (4) customer segments prepared. If no objections I’ll schedule and set the DeployBot to run the phased rollout.

Sara L: No objections.

Alex G: Approved.

Mike S: Thanks — scheduling now. I’ll post the scheduled statuspage link here once T-24h is live. :rocket:
